title: Nx Complete Task Caching
description: Setup the complete monorepo to use proper caching on every build, dev, test, lint, generate, schema, verify, stdio, cpp, wasm and other deterministic Nx step. Every Rust, wasm, npm, etc output is cached on package level (Cargo crate, npm package, ...). There is a single cache location that every agent and dev shares, so disk is bounded by codebase size and build history instead of by the number of concurrent agents (no private per-agent CARGO_TARGET_DIRs). Continuous targets (dev, serve, watch, start) stay uncached themselves but consume cached package outputs. Mutating setup/deps/clean/publish stay uncached. Cache hits must be correct; cache misses only when inputs change. Evidence: plugin targetPolicy, policy.json, project metadata, runtime cache-hit/miss checks, shared cargo build-dir with fine-grain locking, and bounded cache pruning.
summary: One shared cache root .🧬semio/🦑️repo/⚡️cache for all agents: .cargo/config.toml moves build.target-dir/build.build-dir there with nightly -Zfine-grain-locking, -Zbuild-dir-new-layout and -Zchecksum-freshness (verified: concurrent builds block per unit only, private target-dirs reuse shared intermediates, touched sources rebuild nothing), sccache removed, Nx cacheDirectory moved there (hits preserved), Vite/Storybook/vitest caches and Playwright browsers routed there. Central resolvers cargoDirectories/cargoTargetDirectory and repoCacheDirectory replace every private target-dir and target/ path guess across library, root script, os modules, dev, s plugins, hub, launch configs and devcontainer; hub headless-Stdio capture and other deps/ consumers made layout-independent via cargo JSON artifacts. Bounded growth: schema-first storage budgets, repo:cache-report/cache-prune (age, LRU budget, relatime 48h guard, lease, cancellation, test-evidence retention; disk-prune merged in), throttled auto-prune after native cargo runs, clean delegates to it and removes only CACHEDIR.TAG cargo targets outside the root. Nx: every cached target hashes its exact script import closure, root router/git/launcher commands classified via schema uncachedExact, generator freshness guards and React prepare cached with sound inputs, WGPU dev consumes Nx component/materialize outputs, repo:audit 322 -> 0 violations. Freed ~164 GB of stale private targets. Coordinator review fixed a clean rule that would delete 🎯️targets source folders, a whole-graph plugin outage, and Vite stale-dep reload under the moved cacheDir. Manual bookkeeping: repo MCP failed to connect (invalid initialize params). Details: 📓️2026-09-11-coordinator-log.md, 📓️2026-09-11-single-shared-cache-plan.md, lane reports S1-S11.
